main_text.p: ait. Mirari non defino, quòd Ægineta no-uem, aut decem interpositis diebus à uenę sectionibus multis ijsdem medicamentis omnes elephanticos indiscriminatim pur-gauerit pulte ex colocynthide,hiera,& tan-dem sero lactis scissi:cum alteram statuerit erodentem elephantiasin, cui non conue-nit colocynthis pituitæ purgatrix, & alte-ram tuberculosam à crasso sanguine natā, cuius causam tollere nō potis est serum la-ctis:quòd utiq; soli priori elephantiæ gene-ri amplius uidetur. Quem autem humore peculiarem euacuet hoc serum aperte ex-primit Dioscorid.libro,de Medicinali ma-teria secundo,ubi ait ipsum dari, quibus si-ne acrimonia uolumus deiectionem moli-ri,ut melancholicis,comitialibus,lepris,e-lephantijs, & erumpentibus toto corpore papulis. Quibus uerbis serum acres humo-res maximè purgare, aperte docet. Quòd ad qualitatem eius attinet, recentioribus non assentior, qui ipsum esse frigidum di-stitant:imò uerò in primo caloris gradu il-lud ueteres statuerunt,& præsertim Oriba-Cap.3.sius libro Synopseos secundo,Auicenna li-Cap.4008bro Canonis secundo tract.2.&Ioânes MeCap.9.sue libro 2.de Singulis medicamentis pur-ganti-

page.notes: The faint grey pencil mark in the right margin near the top ("aphias" or similar) is handwriting, not printed, and is left out. The marginal references "Cap.3.", "Cap.4008" and "Cap.9." are printed as shown; "Cap.4008" may be a misprint for a different number. The scan is faint in places; "Ioânes" is read with its circumflex as printed.
